title: Present Perfect + for / since; How long…?
en:
For situations that started in the past and continue now, use the Present Perfect (not the Present Simple): I've worked here for six years. (I still work here.)

for + a period: for two weeks, for a long time, for ages. since + a starting point: since 2019, since Monday, since I was a child.

Question: How long have you…? How long have you known him?

With action verbs you can also use the Present Perfect Continuous: I've been waiting for an hour.
ru: Ситуация началась в прошлом и продолжается сейчас → Present Perfect (I have worked here for six years), а не Present Simple. for + период (for 5 years), since + начальная точка (since 2019). Вопрос: How long have you…?

boss.situation: Write about your experience: how long you have worked here, since when you have done each task, how long you have known your manager.
samples: I've worked at the refinery since 2018.
I've been in internal control for six years.
I've used this system for two years.
I've been learning English since last spring.

qs.q: I've lived here ___ ten years.
She has worked here ___ 2019.
How long ___ you known Aigerim?
I ___ him for five years.
We've had this car ___ we moved to Atyrau.
He's been ill ___ Monday.
They've been married ___ a long time.
I ___ in this department since March.
“I am here since 9 o'clock” is correct.
qs.exp: Correct: I've been here since 9 o'clock.

qs.q: “for” is used with a period of time, “since” with a starting point.
I've worked in internal control ___ six years.
a: for

qs.q: We've used this system ___ 2021.
a: since

qs.q: How long ___ you had this phone?
a: have

qs.q: She ___ (be) my manager since last year.
a: 's been
has been

qs.q: I ___ (not / see) him since the meeting.
a: haven't seen
have not seen

qs.q: I've been waiting ___ an hour!
a: for

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: how long have you worked here

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i have known her since we were children

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: we have used this system for two years

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: she has been in the meeting since ten

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i have not had a holiday for a year

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: they have lived in atyrau since 2015

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I work here since 2018.”
a: I've worked here since 2018.
I have worked here since 2018.
I have been working here since 2018.
I've been working here since 2018.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I have known him since five years.”
a: I have known him for five years.
I've known him for five years.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “How long do you know your manager?”
a: How long have you known your manager?

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “She has been here for Monday.”
a: She has been here since Monday.
She's been here since Monday.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I am waiting for you for an hour!”
a: I've been waiting for you for an hour!
I have been waiting for you for an hour!
I've been waiting for you for an hour.
I have been waiting for you for an hour.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “We have this car since 2020.”
a: We've had this car since 2020.
We have had this car since 2020.

I have worked here since 2018.
I have been working here since 2018.
I've been working here since 2018.

qs.q: Я знаю его пять лет.
a: I've known him for five years.
I have known him for five years.

qs.q: Как долго ты работаешь в этом отделе?
a: How long have you worked in this department?
How long have you been working in this department?

qs.q: Мы пользуемся этой системой два года.
a: We've used this system for two years.
We have used this system for two years.

qs.q: Она моя начальница с прошлого года.
a: She's been my manager since last year.
She has been my manager since last year.

She's been my boss since last year.

qs.q: Я жду уже час.
a: I've been waiting for an hour.
I have been waiting for an hour.

I have been waiting for an hour already.

qs.q: Я учу английский с прошлой весны.
a: I've been learning English since last spring.
I have been learning English since last spring.
I've learned English since last spring.
